digest.component_or_area: ChatGPT agent guidance for connector-limited Rebar tracker workflows
propositions: General agent guidance does not explain how ChatGPT sessions should recognize connector-limited environments lacking a tracker worktree, native rebar binary, or network access, nor what operations remain safe.

New ChatGPT-specific guidance must document an environment capability check across six dimensions and a precise decision rule defining when native ticket creation is impossible (tracker-worktree dimension fails AND network/binary dimension fails).

When native creation is impossible, guidance must require producing a reviewable fallback ticket payload conforming to export.schema.json's required fields plus description and parent_id, using an agent-generated UUID4 ticket_id that becomes source_id on import, without claiming persistence occurred.
Guidance must name rebar import (or rebar.import_tickets()) as the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path, forbidding raw event-file injection and GitHub Contents-API writes to the tickets branch.

rebar import silently skips records missing ticket_id/ticket_type; in --dry-run mode this produces no warning and no counter increment, so malformed records are detectable only via a would_create + skipped vs total record-count comparison.

Guidance must preserve append-only, optimistic-concurrency, and native-command invariants, keep GitHub as read-only mirror with Gerrit for code changes, and require confirming the target branch head and running rebar validate/fsck around imports.
